pdf.filename: 20_Y.Y. Chen, T. Duval, U.D. Hung, J.W. Yeh, H.C. Shih. Corrosion Science, 47 (2005), 2257-2279.pdf

alloy.preparation: Non-equal-mole seven-component Cu0.5NiAlCoCrFeSi HEA. Pure elements arc melted on a water-cooled copper hearth under purified argon; ingots repeatedly turned over, remelted and solidified to obtain a completely alloyed state; solidified in a water-cooled copper mold. Bulk cut with a water-cooled grinding wheel into 2 mm thick, 1.91 cm long × 0.89 cm wide pieces; cold mounted in epoxy with exposed area 1.7 cm². Before each electrochemical test, mechanically polished with 600–1500-grit emery cloths, thoroughly cleaned with distilled water and acetone, and finally dried in air.
alloy.microstructure: Reported HEA solidification structure is almost entirely amorphous: dendritic phase mainly amorphous with a small BCC component; interdendritic phase amorphous with small amounts of nanoscale precipitates. The TEM passage calls its specimen as-stamped, without supplying a stamping schedule; no separate stamping treatment is stated for polarization specimens.

test_solution.preparation: Reagent-grade NaCl and H2SO4 (Merck), as applicable, dissolved in distilled water. Deaerated by bubbling purified nitrogen before and throughout polarization; duration not stated. The paper says pH of other solutions was adjusted with HCl or NaOH, but does not provide the resulting pH for this mixture/concentration.

test_method.procedure_description: Three-electrode cell: specimen working electrode, saturated calomel reference and smooth platinum-sheet counter; EG&G model 273 potentiostat/galvanostat with computer interface. Specimen cathodically polarized at −2.0 V relative to Ecorr for 1 min to reduce surface oxides. Test cell contained 1000 ml of constantly stirred solution under thermostatic conditions, at reported room temperature approximately 25 °C. Anodic scan automatically terminated at 100 mA anodic current or E = 1.241 V, whichever occurred first. Three tests per condition. The separate cyclic-sulfate scans and +100 mV/15 min imaging treatments are not the registered anodic measurements.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Potential at which a continuous increase in anodic current indicated sustained localized breakdown of the passive film. The 100 mA/1.241 V values are scan-termination limits, not the pitting criterion.

experiments.result_note: Explicit pitting potential. The paper reports three tests per condition, but does not supply individual replicate potentials or uncertainties here. Composition is the Table 1 ICP-AES wt% analysis; no balance or atom/weight conversion is calculated. Table dashes remain null. The nominal at% example used to calculate equivalent weight is not substituted for the measured analysis. The numerical 25 °C test temperature is explicitly reported as approximate room temperature; it is not an assumed typical temperature. Individual replicate potentials and a statistical aggregation rule are not supplied.

experiments.result_note: Figure 13 explicitly labels the corresponding chloride-containing results Epit; the chloride-free sulfate Eb is excluded. Composition is the Table 1 ICP-AES wt% analysis; no balance or atom/weight conversion is calculated. Table dashes remain null. The pH 0.5 reported for chloride-free 1 N H2SO4 is not assigned to these mixed solutions. The numerical 25 °C test temperature is explicitly reported as approximate room temperature; it is not an assumed typical temperature. Individual replicate potentials and a statistical aggregation rule are not supplied.
